steps.action: Open https://www.saucedemo.com
steps.expected: The login page with Username and Password fields is shown

steps.action: Enter standard_user / secret_sauce and click Login
steps.expected: The Products page is shown

test_cases.title: Login with valid credentials as standard user

steps.action: Open https://www.saucedemo.com
steps.expected: The login page is shown

steps.action: Enter standard_user / secret_sauce and click Login
steps.expected: The Products page is shown

test_cases.title: Login with a wrong password is rejected

steps.action: Enter standard_user / wrong_password and click Login
steps.expected: The user stays on the login page and sees "Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service"

test_cases.title: Login with an unknown username is rejected

steps.action: Enter unknown_user / secret_sauce and click Login
steps.expected: The user stays on the login page and sees "Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service"

steps.action: Enter locked_out_user / secret_sauce and click Login
steps.expected: The error "Epic sadface: Sorry, this user has been locked out." is shown and the Products page does not open

test_cases.title: Empty username shows a required-field error

steps.action: Leave Username empty, enter secret_sauce as the password and click Login
steps.expected: The error "Epic sadface: Username is required" is shown

test_cases.title: Empty password shows a required-field error

steps.action: Enter standard_user, leave Password empty and click Login
steps.expected: The error "Epic sadface: Password is required" is shown

test_cases.title: Products page lists six products with full details

steps.action: Count the products on the Products page
steps.expected: Exactly six products are listed

steps.action: Check each product card
steps.expected: Each card shows a name, a description, a price and an "Add to cart" button

test_cases.title: Sort products by name Z to A

steps.action: Check the sort menu without changing it
steps.expected: Name (A to Z) is selected and products are in alphabetical order

steps.action: Choose Name (Z to A)
steps.expected: Products are listed in reverse alphabetical order

test_cases.title: Sort products by price in both directions

steps.action: Choose Price (low to high)
steps.expected: Each product's price is greater than or equal to the one before it

steps.action: Choose Price (high to low)
steps.expected: Each product's price is less than or equal to the one before it

test_cases.title: Adding a product updates the cart badge and button

steps.action: Click "Add to cart" on the first product
steps.expected: The cart badge shows 1 and the button changes to "Remove"

test_cases.title: Adding all six products shows 6 on the badge

steps.action: Click "Add to cart" on all six products
steps.expected: The cart badge shows 6 and every button reads "Remove"

test_cases.title: Removing a product from the Products page
preconditions: One product is in the cart

steps.action: Click "Remove" on the product in the cart
steps.expected: The cart badge disappears and the button reads "Add to cart" again

test_cases.title: Cart page lists added products
preconditions: Two products are in the cart

steps.action: Click the cart icon
steps.expected: Both products are listed with quantity, name and price

steps.action: Check the buttons on the page
steps.expected: "Continue Shopping" and "Checkout" buttons are shown

test_cases.title: Checkout information fields are required
preconditions: One product is in the cart

steps.action: Click Continue with all fields empty
steps.expected: "Error: First Name is required" is shown

steps.action: Fill First Name only and click Continue
steps.expected: "Error: Last Name is required" is shown

steps.action: Fill First Name and Last Name only and click Continue
steps.expected: "Error: Postal Code is required" is shown

test_cases.title: Order overview total equals item total plus tax
preconditions: Two products are in the cart

steps.action: Complete "Checkout: Your Information" and click Continue
steps.expected: "Checkout: Overview" lists both products

steps.action: Compare Item total with the listed prices
steps.expected: Item total equals the sum of the two prices

steps.action: Compare Total with Item total and Tax
steps.expected: Total equals Item total + Tax

test_cases.title: Finishing an order empties the cart

steps.action: Click Finish
steps.expected: "Thank you for your order!" is shown

steps.action: Look at the cart icon
steps.expected: The cart badge is not shown

test_cases.title: Complete checkout information continues to the overview
preconditions: One product is in the cart

steps.action: Enter Jane / Doe / 12345 and click Continue
steps.expected: "Checkout: Overview" is shown
